blocks.text: BAYOMBONG, Nueva Vizcaya — A wayward 18-wheeler truck rammed four electric power poles, dragged lines along the national highway, and caused a brownout in Barangay Magsaysay in Bayombong, Nueva Vizcaya, on Wednesday. The truck driver encroached into the left lane and struck the poles one after another before it eventually tilted to its side. Police said initial reports suggest the truck driver fell asleep at the wheel, while another report says the steering wheel had malfunctioned.
